212	class Select2TagsField(fields.StringField):
213	    """`Select2Tags <http://ivaynberg.github.com/select2/#tags>`_ styled text field.
214	
215	    You must include select2.js, form-x.x.x.js and select2 stylesheet for it to work.
216	    """
217	
218	    widget = admin_widgets.Select2TagsWidget()
219	    _strip_regex = re.compile(
220	        r"#\d+(?:(,)|\s$)"
221	    )  # e.g., 'tag#123, anothertag#425 ' => 'tag, anothertag'
222	
223	    def __init__(
224	        self,
225	        label: T_TRANSLATABLE | None = None,
226	        validators: list[T_VALIDATOR] | None = None,
227	        save_as_list: bool = False,
228	        coerce: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = text_type,
229	        allow_duplicates: bool = False,
230	        **kwargs: t.Any,
231	    ) -> None:
232	        """Initialization
233	
234	        :param save_as_list:
235	            If `True` then populate ``obj`` using list else string
236	        :param allow_duplicates:
237	            If `True` then duplicate tags are allowed in the field.
238	        """
239	        self.save_as_list = save_as_list
240	        self.allow_duplicates = allow_duplicates
241	        self.coerce = coerce
242	
243	        super().__init__(label, validators, **kwargs)
244	
245	    def process_formdata(self, valuelist: t.Sequence[str] | None = None) -> None:
246	        if valuelist:
247	            entrylist = valuelist[0]
248	            if self.allow_duplicates and entrylist.endswith(" "):
249	                # This means this is an allowed duplicate (see form.js,
250	                # `createSearchChoice`), so its ID was modified. Hence, we need to
251	                # restore the original IDs.
252	                entrylist = re.sub(self._strip_regex, "\\1", entrylist)
253	            if self.save_as_list:
254	                self.data = [  # type: ignore[assignment]
255	                    self.coerce(v.strip()) for v in entrylist.split(",") if v.strip()
256	                ]
257	            else:
258	                self.data = self.coerce(entrylist)
259	
260	    def _value(self) -> str:
261	        if isinstance(self.data, list | tuple):
262	            return ",".join(as_unicode(v) for v in self.data)
263	        elif self.data:
264	            return as_unicode(self.data)
265	        else:
266	            return ""

271	        if self.raw_data:
272	            return self.raw_data[0]
273	        elif self.data:
274	            # prevent utf8 characters from being converted to ascii
275	            return as_unicode(json.dumps(self.data, ensure_ascii=False))
276	        else:
277	            return "{}"
278	
279	    def process_formdata(self, valuelist: t.Sequence[str] | None) -> None:
280	        if valuelist:
281	            value = valuelist[0]
282	
283	            # allow saving blank field as None
284	            if not value:
285	                self.data = None
286	                return
287	
288	            try:
